rationale: Move the Bend compiler pin from ff7a40cc9070a34c78399ecd2bbe46a044ad9b4b (Bend 2.0.25) to upstream main 6a77e1246c351055cb15031267a7c76c87036cbc (Bend 2.0.26); Bun 1.4.2 unchanged. Upstream added hub package names (import name@version, --publish name@version, bend link, bend login), which this project does not use and whose publishing commands it does not run; moved the channel runtime into effs/chan.c and effs/chan.js (this project uses no channels); and reduced comp.ts with output stated byte-identical except channel programs. The non-draft browser build before the pin and the draft build after it produce the same content version 361b9895746876a71757. Frozen manifests stay byte-identical; every v1, v2, mutation, library and browser-build gate passed under the new pin before this amendment was recorded; no law, proof, implementation, fixture or reference byte changed.

toolchain.target: browser JavaScript; native parallelism not yet measured
